name: NY-25
label: Safe D

key_factors: District leans Democratic by about 10 points on the partisan baseline
Incumbent Joseph Morelle has a large financial edge, with over $2.2 million raised versus roughly $30,000 for his Republican opponent
Prediction markets price the Democratic side near 97%
No public polls or expert ratings, so the forecast rests on fundamentals
model.rationale: The fundamentals point strongly to Morelle: a Democratic-leaning district, incumbency, and a dominant fundraising advantage against a barely funded challenger. Markets agree, pricing this as effectively decided.
model.watch: A major polling surprise or a late outside-spending surge for McIntyre would be the only realistic path to revising this downward.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Joseph Morelle, the Democratic incumbent, is seeking another term in a Rochester-area district that leans about ten points Democratic. He has raised more than $2.2 million and holds over $530,000 in cash, while Republican Virginia McIntyre has raised only about $30,000 and has no meaningful outside support. No outside groups are spending against Morelle.

With no public polls and no expert ratings of the race, the picture rests on fundamentals, and those all favor the incumbent. Prediction markets put Democratic odds near 97%, consistent with a comfortable double-digit expected margin and little realistic chance of an upset.
